assumptions.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will pay USD 100 for a digital template pack that helps them track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create a landing page with a one-time purchase link and track the number of clicks and sign-ups within one week.

assumptions.text: Freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region will find the bilingual (Arabic and English) template pack useful for their workflow.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Survey 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to understand their needs and whether they would find the bilingual template pack useful.

assumptions.text: Freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region will prefer a one-time purchase model over subscriptions.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Survey 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to understand their preference for payment models.

assumptions.text: The founder has the necessary skills to create a digital template pack using Notion and Google Sheets.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create a sample template pack and distribute it to 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region, then ask them to use it for a week and provide feedback.

assumptions.text: There is insufficient evidence to confirm a demand for a bilingual digital template pack at USD 100.
assumptions.cheapest_test: Create a landing page with a one-time purchase link and track the number of clicks and sign-ups within one week.

assumptions.text: No commitment signals were observed from interviewees, such as interest in paying for a template or using a bilingual tool.
